rows.abstract:
Intends to remedy the misgivings of formulating a specific IRR in achieving the goals identified
under Sec.64 of R.A.No.8371 which is to give our indigenous fellowmen the opportunity to own the land they till.

Aims also to empower and allow them to seek financial and technical assistance to improve their production, hence extends for another twenty (20) years the option to secure a Certificate of Title under the Land Registration Act 496, as amended, as provided for under the IPR Act.

rows.title_full: AN ACT DECLARING A NATIONAL POLICY THE PROMOTION OF FINANCIAL LITERACY AS A TOOL FOR POVERTY ALLEVIATION AND NATIONAL DEVELOPMENT
rows.abstract:
Proposes to create a Council primarily responsible in providing assistance in formulating policies
related to the promotion of financial literacy as a national concept, promoting exchange of information
on financial literacy between public and private sectors, and monitoring and evaluating financial 
literacy programs.

Intends to harness schools and workplaces as learning environments, integrating financial literacy in
anti-poverty programs, and multi-channel delivery of learning tools and information.

rows.title_full: AN ACT EXEMPTING DIVIDENDS FROM INCOME TAX AND ABOLISHING THE IMPROPERLY ACCUMULATED EARNINGS TAX, AMENDING FOR THIS PURPOSE SECTIONS 24(B), 25(A), 32(B) AND 57(A), AND REPEALING SECTION 29 OF THE NATIONAL INTERNAL REVENUE CODE OF 1997, AS AMENDED
rows.abstract:
Intends to exclude from the gross income - \"CASH AND/OR PROPERTY DIVIDENDS ACTUALLY OR CONSTRUCTIVELY RECEIVED BY AN INDIVIDUAL AND A CORPORATION FROM ANOTHER CORPORATION, OR FROM A JOINT STOCK COMPANY, OR FROM AN INSURANCE OR MUTUAL FUND COMPANY OR FROM A REGIONAL OPERATING HEADQUARTERS OF A MULTINATIONAL COMPANY, OR THE SHARE OF AN INDIVIDUAL IN THE DISTRIBUTABLE NET INCOME AFTER TAX OF A PARTNERSHIP OF WHICH HE IS A PARTNER, OR THE SHARE OF AN INDIVIDUAL IN THE NET INCOME AFTER TAX OF AN ASSOCIATION, A JOINT ACCOUNT, OR A JOINT VENTURE TAXABLE AS A CORPORATION OF WHICH HE IS A MEMBER OR A CO-VENTURER\".

Provides that \"the tax on improper accumulation of surplus is essentially a penalty tax designed 
to compel corporations to distribute earning so that the said earning by shareholders could, in 
turn, be taxed\".
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on WAYS AND MEANS since 2019-10-02

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING DIRECT FINANCIAL ASSISTANCE TO FILIPINO RICE FARMERS, ESTABLISHING FOR THE PURPOSE THE PANTAWID MAGSASAKANG PILIPINO PROGRAM, PROVIDING FUNDS THEREFOR, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract:
Aims to fully address the challenges and issues in improving agricultural incomes and competitive-
ness by upholding the objectives of R.A.No.11203 (AN ACT LIBERALIZING THE IMPORTATION, 
EXPORTATION AND TRADING OF RICE, LIFTING FOR THE PURPOSE THE QUANTITATIVE IMPORT RESTRICTION ON RICE, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES)

Seeks to provide direct financial assistance to rice farming households by allocating tariff revenues collected in excess of P10 billion in the form of a conditional cash transfer program.

Mandates the provision of rice insurance to protect rice crops against insurable risks and provides farmers with additional income through temporary employment in government projects.

rows.abstract:
Seeks to address the limited government engagement in the local livestock industry which inhibits its ability to provide swift and timely interventions during emergency situations.

Intends to adjust the rate of pre-slaughter fees by amending R.A.No.1578, thereby increasing the potential collection of necessary funds for the implementation of other programs and projects to improve the productivity of the livestock industry and to protect the welfare of backyard livestock raisers:

a) For cattle, carabaos, buffaloes, horses, mules... (bovine family) - P120.0 per head;
b) For swine - P80.00 per head; and
c) For sheep, goats and deer - P 40.00 per head.

rows.title_full: AN ACT CREATING THE DEPARTMENT OF TECHNICAL EDUCATION AND SKILLS DEVELOPMENT, DEFINING ITS POWERS AND FUNCTIONS, REPEALING REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7796, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE TESDA ACT OF 1994, AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREOF
rows.abstract:
Seeks to recognize that to become globally competitive and labor efficient, there is a need to 
centralize all the State's efforts and resources to manage the country's labor force.

Intends to elevate the TESDA into a Department to strengthen its powers and organizational functions - providing adequate budgetary support, personnel, and resources to further develop its projects and programs.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on GOVERNMENT REORGANIZATION since 2019-10-02

rows.author: G052
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A PRIVATE HOSPITAL DEVELOPMENT PLAN AND PROVIDING ASSISTANCE TO PRIVATE HOSPITALS BY GRANTING OF INCENTIVES
rows.abstract:
Proposes for a Private Hospital Development Plan which will be drawn in coordination with the DOH, 
other government agencies, and NGOs which shall monitor the needs of private hospitals in terms of 
facility, equipment, and human resources.

Seeks to create a Special Private Hospital Fund that will be sourced from real property taxes paid
by the private hospitals which shall be used to finance the improvement of private hospital and
to assist community-based projects in various localities.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HEALTH since 2019-10-02

rows.author: G052
rows.title_full: AN ACT REQUIRING DEVELOPERS OF PROPOSED CONDOMINIUM PROJECTS TO DEVELOP AN AREA FOR SOCIALIZED HOUSING, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NO. 4726 ENTITLED \"THE CONDOMINIUM ACT\"
rows.abstract:
Aims to help mitigate, if not eradicate the backlog of housing needs in the country by requiring
developers of proposed condominium projects to develop an area for socialized housing which is
equivalent to twenty percent (20%) of the total project area or total condominium project cost, at the option of the developer.

Prescribes that the area for such socialized housing component shall be done within the same city
or municipality, whenever feasible, and in accordance with the standards set by the Housing and
Land Use Regulatory Board (HLURB) and other existing laws.
rows.status: Tabled by the Committee on 2020-02-12

rows.author: G052
rows.title_full: AN ACT DECLARING AND DEFINING THE CRIME OF DISTRIBUTING \"BOTCHA,\" \"DOUBLE-DEAD MEAT,\" OR ANY MEAT TAKEN FROM ANY FOOD ANIMAL THAT HAS DIED OF DISEASE, AS A CRIMINAL OFFENSE, AMENDING FOR THIS PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NO. 9296, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS \"THE MEAT INSPECTION CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES\" AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract:
Introduces a comprehensive definition of the crime of unlawfully distributing botcha, double-dead meat, in all its forms, modes of transmission, and variations or derivatives.

Proposes to increase the penalties in its distribution and sale in light of the escalation of abuses, through syndication and otherwise, of proprietors who capitalize on the institutional weaknesses of our importation processes and who increasingly exploit growing market demand of botcha.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on JUSTICE since 2019-10-02

rows.author: G052
rows.title_full: AN ACT PUNISHING DOG MEAT TRADE
rows.abstract:
Seeks to address the failure in the implementation of existing Animal Welfare Act (R.A.No.8485) and 
the Anti-Rabies Act (R.A.No.9482) enacted for the protection of animals in this case dogs, against 
farming or capture, transport, and/or sale of live dogs for purposes of trading dog meat; transporting,
trading, selling, and/or purchasing dog meat; and slaughter of dogs for the purposes of trading dog meat.

Intends to enact stiffer penalties for persons who engage in any of the stages of the dog meat trade,
and to allocate the funds collected therefor on the implementation of this Act.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on AGRICULTURE AND FOOD since 2019-10-02

rows.author: G052
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A LABOR EMPOWERMENT ASSISTANCE PROGRAM, AMENDING PRESIDENTIAL DECREE NO. 442, AS AMENDED, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE LABOR CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract:
Aims to introduce a matching skills approach to employment by providing for a Labor Empowerment
Assistance Program (LEAP) that is linked to TESDA skills training programs for employees who are 
in-between jobs.

Proposes to ensure that financial assistance and trainings required to reduce the gap between knowledge in the educational system or previous employment, and the actual demand of skills - are readily available and accessible to interested workers.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LABOR AND EMPLOYMENT since 2019-10-02

rows.author: F061
rows.title_full: AN ACT POSTPONING THE MAY 2020 BARANGAY AND SANGGUNIANG KABATAAN ELECTIONS, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NO. 9164, AS AMENDED BY REPUBLIC ACT NO. 9340, REPUBLIC ACT NO. 10632, REPUBLIC ACT NO. 10656, REPUBLIC ACT NO. 10923 AND REPUBLIC ACT NO. 10952, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.title_short: Postponing The May 2020 Barangay And Sangguniang Kabataan Elections
rows.abstract:
Aims to postpone the barangay and sangguniang kabataan elections on May 2020 to the second Monday of May 2023 and every one (1) year following a national and local elections.

Provides that the term of office of the barangay and sangguniang kabataan officials elected in the May 2023 elections and subsequently thereafter, shall commence at noon of June 30 next following their election.

States that until their successor shall have been duly elected and qualified, all incumbent barangay and sangguniang kabataan officials shall remain in office unless sooner removed or suspended for a cause. Barangay and sangguniang kabataan officials who are ex officio members of the sangguniang bayan, sangguniang panlungsod, or sangguniang panlalawigan, shall continue to serve as such members in the sanggunian concerned until the next barangay election.
rows.status: Republic Act RA11462 enacted on 2019-12-03
